description: Which part of a row starts a pointer drag. The keyboard grip is the row itself in both shapes — the mode only decides how much of the row a POINTER may grab.

members.name: Handle
members.description: Only the dedicated drag handle starts the drag (the default). The rest of the row keeps its own clicks, links and inputs, which is what a row with actions needs. The handle is a decorative pointer affordance: it carries tabindex=-1 and aria-hidden, so a reader never meets a second tab stop per row.

members.name: WholeItem
members.description: The whole row is the drag surface and the row is also the gesture element the module delegates from. A touch press has to be held for 400 ms before the drag starts, so a tap, a long-press menu and a page scroll keep working. Use it for plain rows that hold no interactive content of their own.
